personality_one_liner: A raw, confident neo-brutalist educational tool that makes generating and solving exams feel tactical, physical, and direct.

spacing.rule: Generous padding with rigid structures. Avoid floating elements; everything is anchored with borders.

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. Neo-brutalism relies on solid colors, thick borders, and hard offset shadows.

screens.name: Yeni (Ana Sayfa)
screens.purpose: A tactical form to generate new exams using AI, acting as the main dashboard entry.

states.loading: Full-screen AI generating state: large display text, rotating or bouncing robot graphic, showing steps (20-60s expected).
states.error: Hard red border box displaying the generation error with a stark 'Tekrar Dene' button.

screens.layout: Scrollable single column. Grade chips (5-12) as a horizontal wrapping flex list. Text input for topics. Difficulty (Kolay/Orta/Zor) and Type (Açık uçlu/Test/Karma) as segmented controls constructed with thick borders. Sticky primary 'Yazılı Oluştur' (Yellow) button at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Yazılılarım
screens.purpose: A list of generated exams displaying score badges and average stats.

states.loading: Stark wireframe skeleton cards with 2.5px borders.
states.empty: Illustration of a blank exam paper with 'Henüz yazılı oluşturmadınız.' text.

screens.layout: Top section: Average score stat block (Blue bg, White text, Monospace numbers). List of exam cards: Each card has a hard offset shadow, bold title, grade metadata, and score badge ('Henüz kontrol edilmedi' or 'X/100'). Swipe or tap to delete.

screens.name: Sınav Çözümü
screens.purpose: Focus-driven exam solving view mimicking physical paper on a dark desk.
screens.layout: Full-screen view with a dark `#16130F` background. The exam questions sit inside a white 'paper' card (`surfaceSecondary`) with a 2.5px border and no radius. Multiple choice (A-D) options as bordered pressables. 'Cevaplarımı kontrol et' sticky at the bottom. Upon checking, bottom sheet opens with per-question result status (ok/partial/no/empty), explanations, and final score.

screens.name: Profil
screens.layout: List of bordered rows. Name, Email, About, Logout (Red accent). Bold typography for section headers.

empty_exams.alt: A pencil resting on a multiple choice answer sheet

instructions_to_main_agent: NEO-BRUTALIST BORDERS: All cards, inputs, and buttons MUST use `borderWidth: 2.5` and `borderColor: '#16130F'`. Never use thin or standard borders.

HARD OFFSET SHADOWS (CRITICAL): Do not use standard React Native `elevation` or blurred `boxShadow`. Implement hard offset shadows by placing an absolute-positioned View behind the main element with `backgroundColor: '#16130F'`, `top: 4`, and `left: 4`. The main element must sit above it with `borderWidth: 2.5`.

DOT GRID BACKGROUND: Implement the dot-grid background using an SVG pattern or a repeating View matrix for the `surface` screens (Ana Sayfa, Yazılılarım, Profil). Sınav Çözümü uses solid `#16130F` background.

TYPOGRAPHY ROLES: Use 'Bricolage Grotesque' for all headers/display. Use 'Onest' for body text. Use 'JetBrains Mono' (uppercase) for labels, tags, score badges, and eyebrows. Load them locally using `expo-font` as `@expo-google-fonts` is forbidden per instructions.

COLORS: Stick strictly to the provided palette. Buttons are typically `#FFD43B` (Yellow) or `#2D5BFF` (Blue). Background is `#FFF6E9` (Cream) for normal screens, and `#16130F` (Ink) for the Sınav Çözümü screen to mimic a desk.
No Glassmorphism, no blurs, no soft gradients. Transitions should be fast and linear, avoiding bouncy spring animations.
